signal.rationale: Proxies are research-grade approximations of the institutional scores. required_move is set as a fraction of the ATM straddle implied move so the Expected/Required gate can be met on genuinely moving days. Re-tune after observing live behaviour; never mistake PROXY scores for validated signals.

config_overrides._comment: PAPER-ONLY overrides applied to a copy of PARAMETERS.json for the paper runner. PARAMETERS.json is never modified. IMPORTANT: with the frozen risk caps, a real NIFTY/BANKNIFTY ATM premium (required stop = 20% of premium x lot) always exceeds the Rs 750 cap, so no trade can fire. To watch the strategy trade in paper mode, uncomment an override below (e.g. premium_stop_pct 0.06). The dashboard shows a PAPER-ONLY OVERRIDE banner whenever these are active; such results are NOT valid evidence for live parameters.

exit_management._comment: PAPER-ONLY exit-management tuning: vol_time_stop_fraction exits dead trades once 35% of the holding window has passed and the remaining expected move can no longer reach the target; stop_exit_slippage_frac models gap-through-stop on risk-reducing exits (10% of 1R) so paper drawdown is an honest upper bound; edge_scaled_target gives high expected/required setups more room (up to 3R) and banks marginal ones earlier. None of these loosen the stop, so worst-case per-trade risk is unchanged. All paper-only.

instrument_risk_overrides._comment: PAPER-ONLY: PARAMETERS.json hardcodes per-underlying risk caps (750/1000) that shadow the section-level caps - these must be raised in paper mode too or the RiskCap gate still blocks every real NIFTY/BANKNIFTY trade.

instrument_calibration_status._comment: PAPER-ONLY: PARAMETERS.json marks every underlying UNVALIDATED, which subtracts 20 pts from every candidate score vs the 80-pt excellent threshold - with the frozen config no trade can EVER fire. Paper mode marks direction/liquidity VALIDATED so the strategy can be observed trading on live data. These results are NOT evidence for live parameters; the dashboard shows the override banner whenever this is active.

notes: Paper-only. This runner never places orders. Credentials come from FYERS_APP_ID / FYERS_SECRET_ID env vars; the access token is saved to paper_state/tokens.json after one interactive login and auto-refreshes.
